meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式构建功能或修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再写代码，或需要提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Build features or fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code or need to improve code quality

howto.what: Claude会按照测试驱动开发流程工作：先写测试再写实现，并指导你编写好的测试、避免反模式。
howto.when: 当你要求以测试优先方式构建功能或修复缺陷，提到“红-绿-重构”，或需要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用TDD方式开发用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude会先问测试接口，再写测试和实现。

say.text: 按红-绿-重构循环写一个测试。
say.note: Claude会先写失败测试，再写通过代码。
Claude会检查是否耦合实现、同义反复等。

howto.what_en: Claude works in test-driven development: write a failing test first, then minimal code to pass it, while teaching good test practices and avoiding anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.note: Claude asks for seams, then writes tests and code.
Claude writes a failing test first, then passes it.
Claude checks for implementation coupling, tautologies, etc.
